doc.name: Korea Sets
doc.description: Call this agent over MCP (Streamable HTTP) at https://chainshift-preview.vercel.app/api/order/mcp or plain HTTP (OpenAPI at https://chainshift-preview.vercel.app/order/openapi.json); it does not speak the A2A task protocol. Korea Sets takes order requests for Korean-version K-beauty sets that are not sold in the US, delivered to the US, Canada and Japan. Totals are estimates until a person confirms by email. No payment is taken.

skills.name: List Korea Sets offers
skills.description: Korean-version K-beauty sets not sold in the US, with contents and delivered totals.

skills.name: Estimate a delivered total
skills.description: Delivered total (items, shipping, duties) of one parcel to the US, Canada or Japan.

skills.name: Plan the cheapest parcels
skills.description: Split sets over the weight limit into the cheapest parcels.

skills.name: Check what to ask the user before a quote
skills.description: Which questions to ask before a quote when the request is vague.

skills.name: Send an order request (no payment)
skills.description: Order request that a person confirms by email. No payment is taken.
